# Hash-locked pytest runtime for the Python 3.8 job in tests.yml.
# pytest.txt resolves only on 3.11+ (pytest 9, pluggy 1.6, iniconfig 2.3 need
# newer Pythons), so 3.8 gets its own lock: the last pytest line that supports
# 3.8, plus exceptiongroup and tomli, which pytest needs below 3.11. tomli and
# exceptiongroup are pinned to pure-Python releases so a single wheel hash each
# is complete. CI installs wheels only, with --require-hashes.
colorama==0.4.6 ; sys_platform == "win32" \
    --hash=sha256:4f1d9991f5acc0ca119f9d443620b77f9d6b33703e51011c16baf57afb285fc6
exceptiongroup==1.2.2 \
    --hash=sha256:3111b9d131c238bec2f8f516e123e14ba243563fb135d3fe885990585aa7795b
iniconfig==2.1.0 \
    --hash=sha256:9deba5723312380e77435581c6bf4935c94cbfab9b1ed33ef8d238ea168eb760
packaging==25.0 \
    --hash=sha256:29572ef2b1f17581046b3a2227d5c611fb25ec70ca1ba8554b24b0e69331a484
pluggy==1.5.0 \
    --hash=sha256:44e1ad92c8ca002de6377e165f3e0f1be63266ab4d554740532335b9d75ea669
pytest==8.3.5 \
    --hash=sha256:c69214aa47deac29fad6c2a4f590b9c4a9fdb16a403176fe154b79c0b4d4d820
tomli==2.0.2 \
    --hash=sha256:2ebe24485c53d303f690b0ec092806a085f07af5a5aa1464f3931eec36caaa38
pyyaml==6.0.2 \
    --hash=sha256:9056c1ecd25795207ad294bcf39f2db3d845767be0ea6e6a34d856f006006083 \
    --hash=sha256:d7fded462629cfa4b685c5416b949ebad6cec74af5e2d42905d41e257e0869f5 \
    --hash=sha256:82d09873e40955485746739bcb8b4586983670466c23382c19cffecbf1fd8706 \
    --hash=sha256:24471b829b3bf607e04e88d79542a9d48bb037c2267d7927a874e6c205ca7e9a \
    --hash=sha256:43fa96a3ca0d6b1812e01ced1044a003533c47f6ee8aca31724f78e93ccc089a \
    --hash=sha256:01179a4a8559ab5de078078f37e5c1a30d76bb88519906844fd7bdea1b7729ff
